indexToCellID.values: permutation of 1..40962 in exact MPAS mesh order

mesh_contract.runtime_selection: read only rank-owned cells by indexToCellID

time_contract.record_semantics: monthly means over the declared Gregorian month bounds
time_contract.anchor: midpoint of each declared month bound
time_contract.interpolation: linear between adjacent anchors with cyclic December-to-January wrap
time_contract.calendar: runtime Gregorian year, including leap-year month lengths
time_contract.cache: two active monthly slabs for rank-owned cells

preprocessing_contract.source: MERRA-2 M2IMNPASM v5.12.4 O3 and H at 3, 2, 1, 0.7, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, and 0.1 hPa
preprocessing_contract.horizontal_method: first-order conservative remapping of air and ozone columns to the exact MPAS mesh; reconstruct ozone mixing ratio only after both remaps
preprocessing_contract.vertical_method: pressure-layer ozone columns from log-midpoint pressure bounds are redistributed by overlap of height bounds onto fixed 5 km layers
preprocessing_contract.source_top_completion: uncovered target-layer fractions above the MERRA-2 source support use the frozen AFGL mid-latitude-summer O3 reference profile
preprocessing_contract.source_bottom_clipping: only source-layer fractions strictly above 45 km contribute to the prescribed column
preprocessing_contract.structural_fields: US Standard Atmosphere 1976 supplies height-grid reference temperature and air number density

runtime_contract.model_column: prognostic MPAS O3 at and below the model top
runtime_contract.prescribed_column: interpolated O3_layer_column strictly above the model top
runtime_contract.failure_policy: fatal on missing field, wrong units or dimensions, duplicate/missing cell IDs, mesh mismatch, invalid climatology time, nonmonotonic vertical coordinate, nonfinite value, negative O3, or uncovered runtime date
